Perform assignments as necessary to implement Gas SCADA telecom network goals and initiatives. Working knowledge on the analysis, maintenance, and troubleshooting of designs using processes such as Point-to-Point Radio Systems, Copper, IoT, Digital Microwave Systems, and Fiber Optics Systems. Strong understanding of telecommunications protocols such as serial, Ethernet (TCP/IP, UDP, etc.) and wireless. An understanding of gas distribution system operations preferred. Knowledge of Antenna Systems Feedline installation and grounding specifications. Knowledge of Fiber Optic Cable splicing and testing. This role provides governance across all IT operational domains and oversees the Incident and Service Management Specialist team and the Service Delivery Manager. The SM ensures operational excellence, service continuity, and alignment with government ICT policies and security standards. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Service Delivery Oversight Provide overall leadership and governance across all IT operations, ensuring smooth functioning of the multi-vendor environment. Ensure all operational activities across Infrastructure, Network, Applications, Cloud, and EUC meet contractual, security, and compliance requirements. Serve as the single point of accountability for service performance, SLA adherence, and overall service quality. Drive operational readiness for new services, changes, patches, deployments, and infrastructure enhancements. Ensure operational risks are identified and addressed proactively. Major Incident & Crisis Escalation Management Act as the top escalation point during Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents, supporting the Incident and Service Management Specialist team as needed. Engage senior vendor leadership when delays, risks, or SLA breaches are identified. Ensure war-room discipline, proper escalation flows, and high-quality stakeholder communication during major incidents. Provide decision-making support to restore services quickly, approve additional resource mobilisation, or escalate to agency leadership. Vendor & Multi-Tower Management Govern and manage all vendors across technical towers, ensuring fulfilment of contractual obligations, KPIs/SLAs, and service responsibilities. Conduct recurring vendor service reviews, performance assessments, and drive corrective actions for underperformance. Ensure all vendors maintain up-to-date documentation, runbooks, escalation matrices, and compliance artefacts. Challenge vendor technical explanations and recommendations where inconsistencies or gaps are detected. Drive collaboration and alignment across multi-tower teams to ensure integrated service delivery. Operational Governance & Process Assurance Oversee consistent execution of ITIL processes across Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Service Request. Ensure compliance with IM8, Government Cybersecurity policies, and internal governance frameworks. Maintain and update operational SOPs, escalation procedures, communication templates, and service playbooks. Work closely with the Service Delivery Manager to uplift process maturity, correct process deviations, and implement operational improvements. Reporting, Performance Visibility & Management Own the delivery of weekly, monthly, and quarterly service performance reports, including: SLA/KPI outcomes Major incident summaries Chronic issues and trend analysis Vendor performance Ongoing improvement initiatives Review incident trends, operational risks, and system health indicators to anticipate issues before they escalate. Present service performance insights, risks, and improvement plans to Government stakeholders and management boards. Required Skills & Competencies Strong technical and operational background across IT domains (Infra, Network, Applications, Cloud, EUC). Advanced experience in vendor management and multi-tower coordination. Strong leadership, customer engagement, and crisis management capabilities. Deep understanding of Government ICT environments, compliance policies, and cybersecurity standards. Excellent communication, reporting, negotiation, and contract management skills. Proficiency with ITIL v4 principles and operational governance models. Strong analytical, structured, and outcome-focused thinking. Qualifications & Experience Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. CISSP or ITIL v4 certification is required (or strongly preferred). 5–8 years of experience in IT service delivery, vendor management, or operational governance roles. Experience managing multi-vendor environments and 24×7 operational teams. Prior experience in Government, regulated ICT environments, or large enterprise environments is an advantage. Demonstrated experience presenting operational insights to senior stakeholders or executive boards. Leadership & Behavioural Attributes Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability across diverse vendor teams. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills. Calm, decisive, and structured during crises; able to lead and support war rooms effectively. Strong documentation and reporting discipline, with attention to accuracy and completeness. High level of integrity, professionalism, and customer-centric mindset.

In specific countries or regions where IMT consists of full-time employees, the IME may also take on people management responsibilities, including recruitment and performance appraisal of IMT personnel. - Own risk identification and management during on-site IT operations execution; surface and consolidate latent risks; follow up to closure; and drive the formation of campus-level solutions. - Aggregate and surface various IT operations issues at the campus in a timely manner; drive cross-team follow-up and remediation of IT operations issues; ensure on-site work is coordinated with teams including infrastructure, basic operation and maintenance, asset, and quality assurance. - Participate on-site in the capability build-out of the IT operations platform, submitting platform requirements, supporting testing and launch, and continuously feeding back platform issues through on-site usage — providing on-site operations evidence for ongoing platform optimization and improving the automation level, work efficiency, and transparency of on-site IT operations. - Assist in completing operations process specifications and knowledge-based construction; continuously update and maintain operations SOPs and the risk case library based on changes in on-site conditions; and improve the coverage of process specifications and the knowledge base across IMT on-site operations scenarios. - In line with the cluster reporting model, work with the IML to promptly respond to various service requests on campus (such as visits and audits) and emergencies (such as urgent incident response), ensuring the orderly execution of all IT operations-related work on campus.
